LESSON: KUANDIKA 2.3.1 INSHA YA MASIMULIZI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe mtindo na muundo
2. kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe mtindo na muundo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe mtindo na muundo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe mtindo na muundo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha ya masimulizi important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe mtindo na muundo
2. kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
